about_the_game:
Welcome to SEA.OK — a world where endless storms and pouring rain are everyday weather, and scavenging the vast ocean is the only way to survive.

You are a resident of an ancient island, lost in the center of a raging sea. For generations, your family has made a living by hauling shipwreck debris, sunken treasures, and rare resources from the depths of flooded cities.

  • Boats for every taste — from an old rusty dinghy to a powerful fully upgraded vessel.

  • Ocean fishing and deep-sea hunting — catch fish, gather resources, and claim rare trophies.

  • Thrill and risk — play high-stakes sea gambling, wagering your hard-earned sea bucks.

  • Multiplayer for up to 5 players — team up with friends or compete for the best loot.

  • Horror atmosphere — dark nights, roaring storms, and dangerous creatures of the deep.

  • Hunt sea monsters — fight both intelligent and savage beings, set traps, and use your harpoon to protect and reclaim your cargo.

  • Exploration — venture to newly emerged islands, flooded settlements, and dangerous underwater ruins.

In SEA.OK, every voyage is a gamble, every find is a chance to get rich, and every storm is a trial of survival.
Sail into the open sea — fortune favors only those bold enough to claim it!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10, 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i5
  • Memory: 2000 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA Geforce GTX 1060
  • Storage: 1500 MB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i7
  • Memory: 4000 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA Geforce RTX 2060
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 1500 MB available space

short_description: SEA.OK is a co-op survival horror set in a world of eternal storms. Explore sunken cities and mysterious islands, catch fish, gather resources, upgrade your boats, and battle sea monsters in co-op for up to 5 players.
supported_languages:
English*, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Spanish - Latin America, Simplified Chinese, Korean, Polish, Portuguese - Brazil, Portuguese - Portugal, Romanian, Russian, Japanese
*languages with full audio support
